The 13 concrete certificates in certificates.json were loaded from their immutable Git blob and INDEPENDENTLY recomputed: every 2IJ weighted cell 2^i3^j5^e appears exactly once and each color sum equals (2^I-1)(3^J-1) for all I,J in {3,4,5}² union {4,5,6,7}×{2}. Tiling exponent rectangles by allowed lengths using the interval decompositions in the proof establishes an equal-sum partition at every unbounded admissible (a,b), not just a finite parameter scan. Necessity is largest-divisor <= one class total; sufficiency is the certified tiling. Boundary (a,b)=(2,2) N=180 covered.
